profile.description: Mistral and NVIDIA collaborated to create a multimodal, open-source model with 12B parameter, designed for extensive multilingual conversations and file processing. You can set optional parameters like temperature and verbosity in the settings. Supported file types: DOCX, TXT, XLSX, TSX, CSV, PDF, HTML, JSON, CSS, WEBP, JPG, HEIC, GIF and PNG. Unsupported file types: ODS, RTF, XLS, JS, PY, AVIF, HEIF, MP4, WEBM, WAV and MP3, STL, OBJ. Context window: 128K tokens
